usage: plan-review [-h] [--version] command ...

positional arguments:
  command
    schema     print the plan.json JSON Schema
    init       create a run's .plan-review/work/<id>/ folder (or --prompt
               <name>: <name>-<date>)
    validate   check a plan.json file
    serve      open the viewer for a run's plan
    install    put plan-review's skill and agents where a CLI reads them
    stop       stop a run's detached viewer
    config     print this project's pipeline settings, defaults filled in
    threads    list a run's open comment threads as JSON
    reply      answer a comment thread as the agent
    status     show the owner what the agent is doing with their review
               (latest text wins)
    wait       the next thing the owner did, as one JSON line;
               {"type":"timeout"} if nothing
    branch     the branch name for a run: recorded in its plan, else made
    verdict    a review's verdict: exit 0 PASS, 1 FINDINGS, 2 malformed
    grill      the page grill: post turns, see what is pending
    prefs      the owner's recorded choices: `prefs grill [page|chat]` sets or
               prints the grill mode
    upgrade    update the installed plugin to its newest release
    tree-hash  fingerprint of uncommitted changes (git)

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --version    print the version and exit
branch:
usage: plan-review branch [-h] run_id

positional arguments:
  run_id

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
config:
usage: plan-review config [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
grill:
usage: plan-review grill [-h] {post,pending,decisions,schema} ...

positional arguments:
  {post,pending,decisions,schema}
    post                add the agent's next turn to a run's grill.json
    pending             whether the owner confirmed, and what they did that is
                        not answered yet (JSON)
    decisions           write W/decisions.md from the confirmed grill
    schema              print the JSON Schema of a turn

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
grill decisions:
usage: plan-review grill decisions [-h] run_id

positional arguments:
  run_id

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

usage: plan-review grill pending [-h] run_id

positional arguments:
  run_id

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

usage: plan-review grill post [-h] run_id file

positional arguments:
  run_id
  file        the turn, as JSON (see `grill schema`)

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
grill schema:
usage: plan-review grill schema [-h]

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

  --prompt NAME  start a prompt run named NAME-<today>
